cases.sentence: Ликуйте и веселитесь, потому что вас ждет ___ на небесах!
cases.explain: «великая награда» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Rejoice, and be exceedingly glad, for great is your reward in heaven. For that is how they persecuted the prophets who were before you.

cases.sentence: Говорю тебе истину, что ты не выйдешь оттуда, пока не выплатишь все, до ___.
cases.explain: «последнего гроша» — after the preposition «до», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Most certainly I tell you, you shall by no means get out of there, until you have paid the last penny.

cases.sentence: Если твой ___ влечет тебя ко греху, вырви его и отбрось прочь.
cases.explain: «правый глаз» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: If your right eye causes you to stumble, pluck it out and throw it away from you. For it is more profitable for you that one of your members should perish, than for your whole body to be cast into Gehenna.

cases.sentence: И если твоя ___ влечет тебя ко греху, то отсеки ее и отбрось прочь.
cases.explain: «правая рука» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: If your right hand causes you to stumble, cut it off, and throw it away from you. For it is more profitable for you that one of your members should perish, than for your whole body to be cast into Gehenna.
